chain_actions_signed_tx_atomic.name: chain_actions_signed_tx_atomic
chain_actions_signed_tx_atomic.value: ("chain_actions"."raw_signed_tx" IS NULL) = ("chain_actions"."nonce" IS NULL) AND ("chain_actions"."raw_signed_tx" IS NULL) = ("chain_actions"."signer_address" IS NULL) AND ("chain_actions"."raw_signed_tx" IS NULL) = ("chain_actions"."chain_id" IS NULL)

payments_decision_iff_agent_kind.name: payments_decision_iff_agent_kind
payments_decision_iff_agent_kind.value: CASE WHEN "payments"."kind" IN ('OWNER_SPEND', 'WITHDRAW_RESERVE') THEN "payments"."decision_id" IS NULL AND "payments"."rationale_hash" IS NULL ELSE "payments"."decision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."rationale_hash" IS NOT NULL END

payments_line_iff_not_reserve.name: payments_line_iff_not_reserve
payments_line_iff_not_reserve.value: CASE WHEN "payments"."kind" = 'WITHDRAW_RESERVE' THEN "payments"."line_key" IS NULL AND "payments"."line_id" IS NULL ELSE "payments"."line_key" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."line_id" IS NOT NULL END

payments_milestone_ref.name: payments_milestone_ref
payments_milestone_ref.value: "payments"."kind" NOT IN ('FUND_MILESTONE', 'RELEASE_MILESTONE') OR ("payments"."order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."milestone_idx" IS NOT NULL)

payments_signed_tx_atomic.name: payments_signed_tx_atomic
payments_signed_tx_atomic.value: ("payments"."raw_signed_tx" IS NULL) = ("payments"."nonce" IS NULL) AND ("payments"."raw_signed_tx" IS NULL) = ("payments"."signer_address" IS NULL) AND ("payments"."raw_signed_tx" IS NULL) = ("payments"."chain_id" IS NULL)

payments_nonce_consumed_by_foreign_tx.name: payments_nonce_consumed_by_foreign_tx
payments_nonce_consumed_by_foreign_tx.value: "payments"."nonce_consumed_by_tx_hash" IS NULL OR ("payments"."tx_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."nonce_consumed_by_tx_hash" <> "payments"."tx_hash" AND array_position("payments"."superseded_tx_hashes", "payments"."nonce_consumed_by_tx_hash") IS NULL)

payments_reverted_has_receipt.name: payments_reverted_has_receipt
payments_reverted_has_receipt.value: "payments"."state" <> 'REVERTED' OR ("payments"."block" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."tx_hash" IS NOT NULL)
